journey.title: Review a topic and record a verdict
journey.purpose: An operator review session: read the review's evidence and media on the phone, record a verdict per topic in the operator's own words, and see the topic's mission realigned only by that explicit action.

steps.intent: Pick a review session from the list.
Read REVIEW.md and its media, or open REVIEW.html in its own tab.
Record a verdict on a topic after confirming the exact entry.
See the topic's last review linked beside its research write and mission edit.
